title: After the St. Lite Kinen: Sixth Sense

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Manhattan Cafe runs wonderfully at the St. Lite, and it's all thanks to the prep work we've been putting in since spring.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although her stamina is improving, her nails are still worryingly brittle.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nevertheless, with backing from both her friend and Agnes Tachyon, Manhattan Cafe decides to run in the Kikuka Sho.
